review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. smart-base.js and loader.js, the two files the lessons are read against, are byte-identical to the last review. What moved in Smart is styling and wording: the drawer, context menu, modal and datepicker read the surface radius role instead of the old default name, the slider fallback template writes radius-surface, and the country code field gives the mask its digits through a setter that now exists. No attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference changes, so none of the eight lessons changes.
